positions.title: Lead Merchant Integration Engineer
positions.description:
PayWithMyBank allows you to pay or get paid easily by connecting to your online banking account without leaving the merchant’s site or app. Using our secure portal, you simply log in to your online banking with the bank login information you know by heart. The merchant never sees your login info, and there is no account to create, no card, bank numbers or billing info to provide, and no new password to remember. Your bank verifies your identity, and provides the same security you trust daily for online banking.
Our VerifiedACH™ platform confirms your bank account standing, eliminating the risk of non-sufficient funds and associated bank fees, or failed payments due to bank account number keying errors.
PayWithMyBank is immediately available to anyone with a US bank account. Online merchants save on payment fees, nonprofits put more donation dollars to their cause, and insurance companies and other paper check issuers move disbursements online.
Founded in 2012, PayWithMyBank is located in Silicon Valley, California. Our Chairman is the former President of American Express’ Consumer Card Group. Our investors include Balderton Capital, Wellington Partners and TTV Capital. Our customers include the #1 e-commerce payments company in the US, the #1 nonprofit in the US, and the #1 money transfer company worldwide.

positions.title: Contract Engineer
positions.description: Primarily focused on adding new features/enhancement to an existing Due Diligence System including but not limited to front-end development using XUL, javascript, MySQL database enhancement/maintenance as well as backend coding.

positions.title: Yahoo! Tech Engineer, Sr.
positions.description:
•	Mainly responsible for knowledge transfer of existing codebase into the Yahoo! grid
•	Acted as SCRUM Master and managing projects across various teams both locally and internationally    
•	Enhanced and added new features as required by major stakeholders.
•	Actively involved with the continuous integration of such new features into existing Yahoo! Properties.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Helped in engineering a 3-tiered solution to be implemented in PHP5 with heavy use of OOP techniques
•	Build an Assignment Desk aka Call For Content that extends the publication framework.  The core objective being to be able to target Contributors with specific assignments requests from varying Partners; this was not just a simple email sent to our Contributor. It was a module with sufficient intelligence that helped the company leveraged content production via tapping into its Contributors’ knowledge base.  Before being acquired the company would file for a patent( see, http://www.patentbuddy.com/Patent/Profile/20110225290/6362226
•	Took primary lead in the conversion of an application framework from ColdFusion to PHP5 also converting such application into the respective tiers; This includes but is not limited to splitting up the core publication application into objects for the backend, a form handler module for the presentation and capturing of content being submitted by Contributors, and data layer for handling data CRUD activities. This application framework matured over the years but because of it’s initial state made for fairly seamless integration and scalability.  Before being acquired the company would file for a separate patent see: 
 http://www.patentbuddy.com/Patent/Profile/20110225239/6362175
•	Completed a build-out of an Asset Collection Management System; This application will extend from the existing OO framework. Its primary purpose is to give users the ability to upload single/multiple assets(images, text, audio, video).

patents.title: Targeting Content Creation Requests to Content Contributors
patents.description: An assignment system and method for generating content creation requests or "assignments" and targeting assignments to content contributors. The assignment system is part of a content distribution system that aggregates, manages, and distributes/syndicates multimedia content that is generated by content contributors. As part of the acquisition of content, the assignment system may compensate the content contributors for the content that they provide to the system. The assignment system generates assignments that are likely to result in content that will be of interest to content consumers.

patents.title: GENERATION OF CONTENT CREATION REQUESTS FOR A CONTENT DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM  Read more: http://www.faqs.org/patents/app/20110225239#ixzz2EtGkXhCm
patents.description: An assignment system and method for generating content creation requests or "assignments" that are to be fulfilled by content contributors. The assignment system is part of a content distribution system that aggregates, manages, and distributes/syndicates multimedia content that is generated by content contributors. As part of the acquisition of content, the assignment system may compensate the content contributors for the content that they provide to the system. The assignment system generates assignments that are likely to result in content that will be of interest to content consumers, such as visitors and/or subscribers to websites provided by, associated with, or using the content of the content distributor. In some embodiments, the assignment system may generate assignments based on the popularity of pre-existing content, searches for content, or requests for content. The assignment system also manages the flow of content submissions and verifies that submitted content meets the assignment's requirements.
